decision: Wrote Mira's ruling as ADR 0024 in mira-decisions, using her own words and the reserved number. It is a person's direction, so it belongs in an ADR. I changed no code, since the mailer already saves, reads back and mails the copy. The ADR linter passed.

recorded.info: New ADR 0024 (Accepted, 2026-10-23). Report emails in mira-app src/report_mailer.js must save the report, read it back from the store and mail the copy that came back, so the kept copy is the copy the shop received. Reason: a total disputed in September could not be shown as sent. Includes Mira's verbatim words. Not committed.
